About.title: About Me
About.p1: Software Developer focused on DevSecOps, clean architectures, and high-performance distributed systems.
About.p2: Artificial Intelligence & Cybersecurity Engineering student at Universidad Bolivariana del Ecuador (UB). Guided by Christian values of integrity, excellence, and service.

Projects.subtitle: Production systems engineered with clean architecture, high availability, and extreme resource efficiency.

Cloud.title: Cloud, DevSecOps & Cybersecurity
Cloud.pillar1Desc: High-availability cloud deployments on AWS Lightsail optimized to run deterministically on 1 GB RAM with Nginx and PM2.
